title: Contribution Interaction Record
description: A machine-readable record for evidence-backed contribution interactions among two or more contributors in relation to a shared outcome.

protocol.description: Canonical protocol identifier for contribution interaction records.

interaction_id.description: Unique identifier for this contribution interaction record.

contributors.description: Two or more contributors participating in the claimed interaction.

interaction_type.description: Classification of the observed interaction among contributors.

individual_receipt_refs.description: Optional references to individual Causal Contribution Receipts associated with contributors in this interaction.

outcome_id.description: Identifier of the outcome affected by the interaction.

outcome_ref.description: Reference to the outcome or its trace record.

contributor_id.description: Identifier of a contributor participating in the interaction.

receipt_ref.description: Optional reference to the contributor's individual contribution receipt.

trace_refs.description: Trace references showing the contributors participating in the claimed interaction.

comparison_refs.description: References to comparison, ablation, substitution, or counterfactual runs supporting the interaction claim.

downstream_refs.description: References to downstream processes or outputs affected by the interaction.

interactionEvidence.description: Evidence supporting the interaction claim. Interaction claims must be grounded in traceable records.

joint_effect.description: Estimated magnitude of the joint effect of the contributors on the outcome.

synergy.description: Estimated interaction effect beyond the contributors' independently observed effects. Positive values indicate positive synergy; negative values indicate interference or antagonistic interaction.

dependency.description: Estimated degree to which the contributors depended on one another for the observed joint effect.

evidence_strength.description: Strength of the evidence supporting the interaction assessment.

interactionAssessment.description: Independent observations describing the contribution interaction. These values do not directly determine attribution, entitlement, royalty, or settlement.

method.description: Counterfactual method used to evaluate the interaction.

observed_delta.description: Observed quality difference between the baseline and comparison condition. This value is evidence, not absolute causal truth.

comparison_description.description: Human-readable description of what was removed, substituted, or otherwise changed in the comparison condition.
